message:
Fixed: "Crème brûlée recipes" now becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`, and `npm test` passes (3 of 3).

The vendored `slugify` strips any character outside `a-z`, so accented letters were deleted instead of reduced to their base letter. `vendor/slugify/index.js` is marked "do not edit by hand", so I left it alone. The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`: `postSlug` now removes accents (Unicode NFD normalisation, then dropping the combining marks) before calling `slugify`.

Shop product URLs (`src/shop/product-url.js`) use the same vendored `slugify`, so they still drop accented letters. I didn't change them because you only asked about blog posts. The same one-line fix would work there if you want it.
